subject: chest
text: A chest in the Focus Tower contains 10 bombs.

evidence.quote:
Pick
up the 10 bombs and check the gold seal on the wall.

subject: chest
text: Heading south on 2F leads to a chest containing your second Black Magic spell.

evidence.quote:
Ascend them to 2F. Turn to your left and head south to reach a 
chest. Yay, you've just picked up your second Black Magic spell.

subject: Battlefield Four
text: Battlefield Four pits you against Mintmints and awards a prize of 99 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Four ~
     =--------------=
          Monsters: Mintmint
          Prize: 99 EXP

subject: chest
text: A chest above the omega tile in Libra Temple contains Explosives.

evidence.quote:
Up ahead is a white tile with an omega symbol on it. Ignore it at the moment.
Above it is a chest and a girl standing next to it. Take some Explosives from
the chest and talk to the other.

subject: Battlefield Five
text: Battlefield Five contains Giant Toads and Mintmints and rewards 300 GP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Five ~
     =--------------=
          Monsters: Giant Toad, Mintmint
          Prize: 300 GP

subject: Battlefield Six
text: Clearing Battlefield Six rewards the Magic Ring.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Six ~
     =-------------=
          Monsters: Giant Toad, Mintmint, Scorpion
          Prize: Magic Ring

subject: Scorpion
text: Scorpions are weak against Fire magic.

evidence.quote:
Scorpions are weak against
             Fire, so those are easily vanquished.

subject: inn
text: The inn in Aquaria restores HP for a fee of 95 GP.

evidence.quote:
The inn up ahead can restore your HP and stuff. However, you'll have to pay a
hefty fee of 95 GP.

subject: Steel Helmet
text: A woman in the house behind Phoebe's sells a Steel Helmet for 200 GP.

evidence.quote:
Before 
heading out, check the house behind Phoebe's. The woman will sell you a Steel
Helmet for 200 GP.

subject: house behind Phoebe's
text: Refreshers can be picked up by the beds in the house behind Phoebe's.

evidence.quote:
Don't forget to pick up the 
Refreshers by the beds.

subject: Phoebe's house
text: Heal Potions can be taken from Phoebe's house in Aquaria.

evidence.quote: If you'd like, you can steal some Heal Potions from Phoebe's house.

subject: Battlefield Seven
text: Battlefield Seven contains Edgehogs, Scorpions, and Giant Toads, with a prize of 99 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Seven ~
     =---------------=
          Monsters: Edgehog, Scorpion, Giant Toad
          Prize: 99 EXP

subject: Edgehog
text: Edgehogs are weak against the Fire spell.

evidence.quote:
Like the Scorpion,
             Edgehogs are weak against the Fire spell.

subject: chest
text: Taking the left path at the entrance of Wintry Cave leads to a chest containing 10 bombs.

evidence.quote:
Head left first and beat up the 
monsters in your way. The chest contains 10 bombs.

subject: Phoebe
text: Phoebe lets Benjamin use her Cat Claws, which allow climbing walls that have steps.

evidence.quote:
She'll let you use her Cat Claws. With them, you can climb walls, but only if
they have steps.

subject: chest
text: Climbing the wall to the right after falling leads to Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
A little bit to your right is a climb-
able wall. Pick up the Heal Potions.

subject: chests
text: Blowing up the cracked wall behind the Centaur leads to chests with Cure Potions and Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Inspect the wall behind where he once stood. At one point is a cracked
wall. Yeah, you guessed it. Bomb time!! Blow it up and continue. There are a 
bunch of monsters here. If you want the Cure Potions and Arrows, beat them all
to clear a path to the chests.

subject: chest
text: A chest guarded by two monsters to the east contains three Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Continue east to find two monsters
guarding a chest. Take three more Cure Potions from the chest.

subject: chest
text: A chest guarded by a Centaur to the south contains Three Refreshers.

evidence.quote:
Keep going south to find a chest. Get the Centaur out of the way first. Three
Refreshers can be found inside.

subject: chests
text: Inside the cracked door, the two chests at the entrance hold three Cure Potions and 10 Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Clear the Edgehog out of the way to 
reveal a cracked door. Place a bomb and blow it to smithereens. Inside is 
another batch of monsters. There are some items here. The two chests you see
at the entrance three Cure Potions and 10 Arrows.

subject: chests
text: Heading southeast in the open room leads to two chests with Heal Potions and Arrows.

evidence.quote:
In the next open section
of this room, you can go northeast to advance or southeast to find two more
chests. Snag the Heal Potions and Arrows.

subject: chest
text: A chest near the boss's platform contains Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Clear a way to the
center platform, of which the boss stands upon. The chest nearby contains 
Arrows.

subject: Squidite
text: Squidite fights alongside two Sparnas and is weak to Phoebe's Thunder spell.

evidence.quote:
Squidite 
          starts the battle with two Sparna allies. Phoebe can easily shoot
          them down with her Bow of Grace. Once those are taken care of, you
          can focus on Squidite itself. Use Phoebe's Thunder spell to take
          advantage of Squidite's weakness to that element.

subject: chest
text: Defeating Squidite reveals a chest containing the Libra Crest.

evidence.quote: Defeating the Squidite will reveal a chest. Open it for the Libra Crest.

subject: Battlefield Eight
text: Battlefield Eight features Desert Hags and rewards a prize of 600 GP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Eight ~
     =---------------=
          Monsters: Desert Hag
          Prize: 600 GP

subject: Desert Hag
text: Desert Hags counter physical attacks that do not kill in one hit and are weak against Fire magic.

evidence.quote:
The problem with Desert Hags is their counter-attack. If you use
             a physical attack (that doesn't kill in one hit), you'll most 
             likely eat a nasty counter-attack. Desert Hags can deal quite a 
             bit of damage if you don't defeat them quickly. Fire magic is 
             your best bet here. Desert Hags are weak against that.

subject: omega tile
text: Stepping on the omega tile in the Libra Temple while holding the Libra Crest brings you to the Life Temple.

evidence.quote:
Now that you have the Libra Crest, stepping on the omega tile will bring you
to the Life Temple.

subject: chest
text: Cure Potions can be found in the Life Temple.

evidence.quote:
Don't
forget to pick up the Cure Potions. When ready, return to Aquaria.

subject: strange man
text: The strange man in the Life Temple saves what was left of the Wakewater in a bag.

evidence.quote:
Luckily, he managed to save 
what was left of the Wakewater in a tiny bag.

subject: ice block
text: Move the first ice block nine spaces up, seven spaces to the left, and one space up to bridge the platforms.

evidence.quote:
Move the ice block nine spaces 
up, seven spaces to the left, and one space up. Once you finish that task, it 
should be in-between the two platforms.

subject: ice block
text: Push the second ice block four spaces to the right and one space up to bridge the gap between platforms.

evidence.quote:
Push the ice block four spaces to the right and one space up. Like before, 
this block should act as a stepping stone between the two platforms.

subject: ice blocks
text: Move the third block four spaces left, one space up, two left, six up, and ten right; push the south block four spaces up, eight right, one down, and three right; re-locate the third block one right, one down, eight right, one up, three right, and one up.

evidence.quote:
With this block, move it
four spaces to the left, one space up, two more spaces to the left, six
spaces up, and ten spaces right. 

Take the other ice block at the south end of the screen. Push it four spaces
up, eight spaces to the right, one space down, and three spaces to the right.
Have it rest right below the last ice block. Re-locate the third ice block.
Push it one square to the right, one square down, eight squares right, one
square up, three more squares to the right, and one square up.

subject: chest
text: A chest past the two ice blocks contains bombs.

evidence.quote:
Hop over the gap and onto the two ice blocks you put into place.
Kill off the Desert Hag and continue. Open the chest for some more bombs.

subject: chest
text: A chest near the boss in Falls Basin contains the Heal spell.

evidence.quote:
The boss is
up ahead but before fighting it, snag the Heal spell from the chest nearby.

subject: Snow Crab
text: Snow Crab fights alongside two Desert Hags, can deal 200+ damage, is weak against Thunder, and uses Tornado when HP is low.

evidence.quote:
The Snow Crap has two Desert Hags to help him out. Have Benjamin
          and Phoebe use Fire to take them down quickly. The Snow Crab has 
          some tough attacks. He can easily deal 200+ damage, so make sure
          that you heal when necessary. Thunder works the best in this battle.
          Have Phoebe cast that while Benjamin either heals or uses Quake. 
          When the Snow Crab's HP is low, he'll begin to use Tornado for very 
          heavy damage.

subject: Jumbo Bombs
text: After defeating the boss, Phoebe introduces Jumbo Bombs, which deal more damage to enemies while blowing up cracked doors.

evidence.quote:
Head up to the cracked door and Phoebe will appear to tell you about Jumbo
Bombs. These upgraded explosives deal more damage to enemies while still 
blowing up cracked doors and the like.

subject: Battlefield Nine
text: Battlefield Nine features Lamias, Desert Hags, and Mages, rewarding 540 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Nine ~
     =--------------=
          Monsters: Lamia, Desert Hag, Mage
          Prize: 540 EXP

subject: Lamia
text: Lamias can inflict sleep or confusion and are weak to Thunder.

evidence.quote:
Lamias on the other hand,
             can put a unit to sleep or confuse them. Have your Heal spell 
             handy for that. Use Thunder to take them down quickly.

subject: Phoebe
text: As Phoebe tries to leave, Benjamin kidnaps her, and you now have a new member who is actually good with magic.

evidence.quote:
As Phoebe tries to leave, Benjamin kidnaps her. You now have a 
new member who is actually GOOD with magic.
